Approved Date: 21 July 2008
Date to be reviewed: July 2013
مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 on compressor motor for C.B 
220 kv, which must be performed on monthly, yearly bases, every six years and 
every 600 operating hours as indicated in the title block.
Technical Specification of Air Compressor:

The compressor proper of Westinghouse design and construction has the following 
nameplate rating:

The first draft initiated by eng. Saad Mahmoud El-Nashaar, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam ,approved by eng. 
Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

يجب أن يكون تصريح العمل 
 الصادرة ويجب أن يحمل موظفو الصيانة المؤهلون الهوية المناسبة 
 فئة السلامة

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

ارتداء معدات السلامة والصحة 
 مثل الخوذة، وأحذية السلامة، وقناع التنفس، ونظارات السلامة

Breaker should be isolated, in 
 full open position and grounding on both sides of CB is required

Switch off control current (dc) 
 for CB

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به
كل شهر

Check the oil consumed during the 
preceding month and if necessary add oil of the same type as used for the last 
filling

إذا لزم الأمر، تقصير الوقت 
الفاصل الزمني بين الفحوصات اللاحقة وإعادة التعبئة وذلك لمنع مستوى الزيت 
من السقوط تحت علامة إضافة مقياس العمق (55 شكل 2)

Make sure that the condensate drain 
valve (14 fig 1) correctly operates

Using a 10 mm allen key loosen and 
re-tighten the condensate drain plugs (13 fig 1) so as to exhaust any condensate 
that might have collected in the receivers (1 fig 1)

sections.text:
Every 200 operating hours or every 
year

Drain the lubricating oil through 
plug (54 fin 2) remove the opposite plug (54 fig2) remove the opposite plug as 
well, clean out the crankcase bottom using, if possible a blast of compressed 
air re-apply plugs and refill with new heavy-duty air - compressor oil

Clean out filter (17 fig 1) and the 
inside of condensate trap (7 fig 1)

Remove the collar that fizes the air 
cleaner toi the suction duct and clean up filter (5 fig 1) with petrol and dry 
it out with compressed air

With piping system at bar check 
safety valve (3, fig 1) for correct operation by pulling up the valve plunger

sections.text: Every 600 operating hours

Strip, clean up, inspect and 
re-assemble the intade and delivery valve assemblies (42-58, fig 2) the 
non-return valve (15 fig 1 ) as well as the breather and oil baffle placed on 
the crankcase rear over (46 fig 2)

items:
Strip, clean up, inspect and 
re-assemble the intade and delivery valve assemblies (42-58, fig 2) the 
non-return valve (15 fig 1 ) as well as the breather and oil baffle placed on 
the crankcase rear over (46 fig 2)

sections.text: Every 6 years

Measure the time the compressor needs 
to bring the air system from atmospheric to the rated operating pressure and 
compare it with the time recorded during the commissioning tests (if possible, 
operate at the same ambient temperature as during those tests)

في حالة وجود نظام خالٍ من التسرب، فإن 
يتجاوز وقت الضخ بأكثر من 15% الوقت الذي تم قياسه باستخدام العلامة التجارية 
معدات جديدة يوصى بتقديم الضاغط إلى المتجر التالي 
صيانة

Disassemble clean up inspect and if 
necessary, replace the intake and delivery valve blades (42 - 58 fig 2) as well 
as the related gaskets

تحقق من تجويف الاسطوانة للخارج 
- دائرية عن طريق قياس قطر الزوايا القائمة والمتوازية 
العمود المرفقي إذا كانت الجولة الخارجية مفرطة، قم بإعادة صقل جدران الأسطوانة 
وبذلك يصل قطر تجويف الأسطوانة إلى قطر المكبس الجديد 
بالإضافة إلى خلوص 0.08 ملم
